method: Independently reload original and derived GLBs from disk; evaluate exact skinning and bone hierarchy at 128 phases per clip, plus explicit once-mode endpoint poses. Geometry, bind skeleton, skin and original clip JSON and binary prefix compared directly. Angular distances use normalized world quaternions; Float32 local quaternion norm errors are separately reported.

limitations: Ankle XZ can change up to 3.35 percent body height when original leg reach constraints clamp an attempted floor target; exact planar foot trajectory preservation is not claimed. Corrected stride is remeasured.
Actual sole minima are measured on foot/Toe weighted vertices >=.5; not a full anatomical segmentation.
The .25 percent body height dense floor tolerance is separate from the exact 32 published render sample requirement: every published sole is above the floor.
This report does not prove browser pose aesthetics or performance.
